effect.name: VHS (Texture) [Type 2]
effect.description: A shader that simulates the VHS tape effect (Type 2; compared to Type 1, this now produces a more realistic effect)
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's VHS (Texture) [Type 2] Shader | 2026.08.25 */
parameter.description: A shader that simulates the VHS tape effect (Type 2; compared to Type 1, this now produces a more realistic effect)

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Frame Counter
parameter.description: A counter used for _Interlacing to determine whether a frame is even or odd; if you are using _Interlacing, always set this value to increment by 1 every frame or to alternate between 0 and 1 (the latter is more recommended)

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: This variable specifies the "blur" size in pixels

parameter.name: Quality
parameter.description: This variable determines the quality; the higher the value, the more work the GPU does.

parameter.name: Interlacing
parameter.description: Interlacing causes every other vertical line to be drawn based on _Frame; it is recommended only when: you are rendering a Direct3D game, the shader is applied to the entire frame, and "Direct3D: don't erase background if the frame has an effect" is CHECKED.

parameter.name: Alpha of the previous frame
parameter.description: Sets the alpha color for the previous frame when _Interlacing is enabled; recommended values range from 0.75 to 0.9; lower values MAY CAUSE EPILEPSY!

parameter.name: Saturation
parameter.description: This variable changes the color Saturation. (Range from 0 to 100)

parameter.name: Value
parameter.description: This variable changes the color Value. (Range from 0 to 100)

parameter.name: Seed
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the noise seed.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: This variable specifies the noise animation timer.
